reason: The best completed primary trial is frozen-feature logistic (trial 3, accuracy 0.8375), but that route is exhausted and not among the available candidates. Among available candidates, rbf_svm is an untried estimator family; C1.0 is a moderate-capacity configuration. Selecting it adds coverage on the primary split without claiming a predicted improvement.
review: Prior primary trials show frozen MobileNet features logistic C10 at 0.8375 accuracy, while pixel logistic and gradient histogram routes are lower. Available untried routes include extra_trees and rbf_svm. This proposal covers rbf_svm C1.0 on standardized pixels.
hypothesis: An RBF SVM on standardized pixel features may capture nonlinear class boundaries not represented by linear pixel logistic; this is a coverage probe, not a verified causal claim.
uncertainty: No primary measurement exists for rbf_svm on this task; expected direction and magnitude are unknown. Pixel features may be weak, and C1.0 may underfit or overfit relative to untested alternatives.
